qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary fashion and footwear e-commerce; non-essential consumer purchases easily deferred during economic downturns amid intense competitive discounting.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (REJECT). Online fashion and footwear retail is non-essential, discretionary, and deferrable. Structural industry headwinds include high return rates (up to 50%), brand disintermediation via direct-to-consumer channels, and fierce competition from ultra-fast-fashion platforms.
qualitative.evidence: Zalando generates >€10B in GMV across European online fashion, but operates with razor-thin operating margins (2-4%) and sub-hurdle multi-year ROIC (<8%). Apparel e-commerce is highly discretionary and sensitive to consumer sentiment. In addition, structural platform economics are impaired by high logistics/return costs and intense competition from low-cost Chinese platforms (Shein, Temu) and direct-to-consumer brand distribution.
